# SparklyTurf

## About
SparklyTurf is a professional artificial turf cleaning company that specializes in eliminating pet odors, stains, and bacteria from synthetic grass. We use eco-friendly, non-toxic, and pet-safe solutions.

## Service Tiers

### Refresh Clean
Essential maintenance: Detailed Inspection, Debris Removal, Surface Brushing, Decompacting, Grooming, Weeds Removal

### Restore Clean
Everything in Refresh, plus: Pet Waste Removal, Vacuuming, Deodorizing, Odor Removal, Infill Top-Up, Re-Fluff

### Deep Clean
Everything in Restore, plus: Stain Removal, Power Washing, Urine Extraction, Infill Replenishment, Drainage Improvement, Re-Infill, Small Repairs

## Pricing Plans
- Refresh Clean (every 3 months): $359/service, 10% off
- Restore Clean (every 2 months): $319/service, 20% off
- Deep Clean (monthly): $279/service, 30% off

## How It Works
1. Request a free quote with your turf dimensions and concerns
2. Schedule a cleaning at a convenient time
3. Our team deep cleans your turf using eco-friendly methods

## Guarantee
100% satisfaction guaranteed. If not satisfied, we re-clean at no cost.
